description: This file is a Python script for stock analysis, including data scraping, processing, statistical calculations, and exporting results for S&P 500 stocks.

methods.name: convert_prices_to_periods
methods.description: Converts price data to percentage returns over specified periods.

methods.name: separate_date_column
methods.description: Extracts month, day, and year from the date column.

methods.name: pivot_the_table
methods.description: Pivots the data to show returns across years and dates.

methods.name: add_calculated_items
methods.description: Adds statistical columns for analysis such as counts, averages, and standard deviations.

methods.name: sortbydate_resetindex_export
methods.description: Sorts data by date and resets index for export.

methods.name: calc_trading_stats
methods.description: Calculates trading statistics like max/min returns, probabilities, and streaks.

methods.name: filter_and_append_stats
methods.description: Filters data based on criteria and appends statistical results to trade list.

methods.name: export_to_excel
methods.description: Exports analysis results to an Excel file with multiple sheets.
